covariant_count_surrogate_contract.alternative: equal-weight Cox mixture with conditional rates mu*(1-delta) and mu*(1+delta)
covariant_count_surrogate_contract.null: N conditional on fixed mu is Poisson(mu)
covariant_count_surrogate_contract.registered_witness_grid_point: mu=2, delta=1/2 gives conditional rates 1 and 3

design.threshold_rule: strict upper tail beyond an independent null-calibration higher-quantile plus a declared four-times GPU/CPU numerical guard

deterministic_manifest.scenario_seed_derivation: little-endian uint32 from first four SHA-256 bytes of colon-delimited design coordinates

gpu_cpu_crosscheck.scope: every statistic for every null and alternative replicate recomputed on CPU from identical GPU-generated counts

interpretation.implementation_stress_test: CUDA generation, reductions, deterministic manifest, and CPU parity
interpretation.non_test: does not test transaction ontology, action derivation, paper validity, QED validity, or real-event correspondence
interpretation.synthetic_falsification_power: finite-sample separability of a declared Poisson null from the registered symmetric Cox witness family

runtime_measurement.scope: device-wide counters during one local run; concurrent GPU work may contribute and lane exclusivity is not claimed

utilization.counter_scope: device-wide NVML samples during synchronized kernels; may include concurrent processes and are not a lane-only or sustained-capacity claim
